output_list.reason: Integer overflow in mintToken function allows the owner to set the balance of an arbitrary user to any value.
The buy function allows the owner to set the balance of the attacker to zero, aka the 'tradeTrap' issue.
The sell function allows the attacker to set the balance of the attacker to any value, aka the 'tradeTrap' issue.
The freezeAccount function allows the owner to set the freeze status of an arbitrary user, which could be used to create a tradeTrap.
The setPrices function allows the owner to set the sell and buy prices, which could be used to create a tradeTrap.
